title: Spot Goes to Hollywood
overview:
Spot goes to Hollywood in his most cinematic extravaganza to date! In this, his newest and coolest adventure, Spot takes a multi-level frolic through Hollywood's greatest film genres.

- Over 20 levels of arcade style action and puzzle gameplay
- 20 minutes of integrated cinematics
- Rich, vibrant graphics with isometric viewpoint and 3-D rendered worlds
- CD quality sound
